text:
jana: Quick heads-up — planning a small sidecar change for the Slate dedicated GPU pool autoscale policy tonight at 22:00 UTC. 30m window. This only touches the sidecar that reads metrics and flips policy flags, not the allocator. Asking for: deploy owner, 2 smoke volunteers, rollback command ready.

liam: I can be primary deploy owner. I'll be online from 21:45–23:30 UTC.

sasha: tagging here — can you paste the smoke checklist? I'll volunteer if short.

alexa: SGTM, I can help with smoke (prefix/cold-start checks).

matt: I'll pre-run the rollback in staging and share the exact commands. will push before 21:30.

jana: Thanks. Smoke checklist (short):
1) confirm sidecar config applied to slate pool nodes
2) send 5x small inference requests to the dedicated endpoint (<= 300ms p50 target)
3) check autoscale metrics ingestion (k8s sidecar logs) for no errors
4) ensure no allocator restarts or OOMs reported

Smoke steps (commands):
```
# watch sidecar pods and logs
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=slate-sidecar
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=slate-sidecar --tail=200

# quick functional check against dedicated endpoint
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
```

Rollback (if sidecar misbehaves):
```
# rollback the sidecar deployment to previous revision (helm or kubectl)
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/slate-sidecar-deploy --to-revision=PREV
# or if helm chart: helm rollback slate-sidecar-release 2 --namespace redwood
```

liam: noted. Matt, can you confirm PREV revision number by 21:30?

matt: yes — staging shows prev=4 for the release. I'll annotate prod playbook with exact number and keep a quick rollback snippet in the runbook.

deploy-bot: Reminder — scheduled deploy window: 22:00 UTC. Please confirm readiness with :thumbsup:.

alexa: :thumbsup: I'm ready for smoke.

sasha: :thumbsup: I'll watch metrics and KV cache hits; ping me if latency > 350ms p95.

jana: Perfect. Oncall, any concerns with night window?

oncall-bot: Oncall rota: liam is primary, sasha backup. Pager rules active. Escalation to eng-sre if allocator restarts >1 in 10m.

liam: I'll start the deploy at 22:00. Plan: apply sidecar config, wait 60s for pods, run smoke steps, if anything fails -> rollback immediately.

sasha: copy. I'll post quick status updates here after smoke.

matt: prep done, rollback command saved in runbook (link: https://git.redwood/runbooks/slate-sidecar-rollback).

jana: Thanks team — moving to green. Will log final rollout outcome in this thread after smoke. :sparkles:
